name: Koodous APK intelligence API
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator (Hispasec), public API documentation and plans, years of public track record as a collaborative Android malware platform (A8 community): 'Tier community (Koodous; Apple and Google are trusted).' (P346 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Community platform: APK metadata (package, app name, company as declared in the APK) plus community detections and votes; detections are context, never a verdict on their own (P346 c7).

error_markers.regex: (?i)request was throttled\. expected available in [0-9]{4,} seconds
error_markers.reason: Koodous: plan limit reached (throttled for more than 15 minutes): could not verify

koodous.description: Koodous API token of the company account (Authorization: Token <token>): APK package/hash lookups of mobile_app_impersonation (P346 c5)
koodous.plan_hint: company account; record the plan with `v3lum keys set koodous --plan business` once the Koodous terms are reviewed for business use (free API plan: 15 searches/day, 4 details/min)

apks.title: Koodous APK search and detail (GET /apks/?search=, GET /apks/<sha256>/): read endpoints only

terms.quote: Koodous only with a company token (key 'koodous', terms recorded, real fixture), for APK hash/package lookups; keyless 401 gives NEEDS_KEY. (P346 final condition 5; Koodous usage limits: Free API 15 searches/day, Fan, Research and Corporate API plans, overall limit of 100 requests per minute)

apks.notes: Research C0781 (keyless GET /apks/?search= -> HTTP 401 'Authentication credentials were not provided.', www-authenticate: Token). Business use is decided by key_plans.koodous (company token). Only the search and detail read endpoints are called: analyze_static/analyze_dynamic/analyze_yara, download, get_upload_url, votes and comments (GET endpoints that change state or move files) are never called. The API answer shape with a token is still to be captured as a real fixture (backlog p2-G03-2).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G03-2 (P346). reuses_queries false: the module only searches and reads APK reports (no upload, analysis request, vote or comment); the terms review of query reuse is in docs/backlog/p2-G03-2.md.
